<div class="review-text">
Cute and interesting. This game sparked my interest in pretty hyperbolic patterns. While the game does great for its innovation, the core "fun" aspect of it is a little bit drowned out by how frustrating and punishing it can be, with an overall very low difficulty level but with extreme, run-ending punishments of tiny mistakes.
